scene.note: You make the folders and the file the studio needs before anything is sorted into them.

steps.note: Idris needs a place for the card machine slips.
A new, empty folder appears in the top folder, beside orders and artwork.
A listing of the top folder shows its name, spelled exactly as asked.
Idris will sort this year's orders into one folder per month.
The year folder goes inside orders, and the months go inside the year.
A listing of the year folder shows all three months side by side.
Maeve wants a folder for rough drawings, and its name has a space.
The shell has to read the two words as one name, or it makes two folders.
artwork lists one new folder, not two.
Maeve keeps a list of what to print next, and wants an empty file to start it.
An empty file appears in the top folder, ready to open in the editor.
The long listing shows it with a size of nothing at all.
